name: Row
pro_tip: Repeat this movement rhythmically for the duration of your cardio.
how_to: Sit on the seat and secure your feet on the pedals with straps while gripping the handle overhand and shoulder-width apart.
Select the appropriate settings on the machine for your planned cardio.
Press start.
Exhale and extend at your legs to straighten them while simultaneously driving your elbows back behind you, leaning back with a flat back, and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Continue so that the seat moves towards the back of the machine, your legs are straight, and elbows pass behind your torso.
Inhale and bend your legs to bring the seat forward while extending your arms and leaning forward, returning you to the starting position.

name: Seated Good Morning
pro_tip: If you can, try to have a spotter assist you during this movement.
how_to: With feet shoulder-width apart, position yourself under the center of the barbell in the rack as you place it between your traps and upper back, and grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell from the rack by partially standing up and taking a step back while squeezing the bar tightly and keeping it rested over your upper back.
Sit down on a bench with your back upright and firmly plant your feet on the ground.
While keeping your butt firmly on the bench, inhale and lean forward with a straight back, gripping the barbell tightly so that the barbell does not slide onto your neck.
Continue until your torso is a 45 angle from the ground.
Exhale and lean backward with a flat back, returning to the starting position.
After all reps are completed, stand up and return the barbell to the rack.

name: Seated Hammer Wrist Curl
pro_tip: If your knees get in the way of you lowering the dumbbells, point your legs more outward.
how_to: Sit on the edge of the bench while leaning forward with your forearms resting on your thighs, holding two dumbbells with your palms facing each other.
Exhale and bend your wrist upwards while keeping your forearms resting on your thighs.
Continue raising the dumbbells by bending your wrists until you can no longer do so by solely bending at your wrists.
Inhale and lower your wrists, allowing the dumbbells to return to the starting position.

name: Seated Lateral Raise
pro_tip: Try to lift the dumbbells mostly through your shoulders, not your lower back.
how_to: Sit on a bench while leaning slightly forward with dumbbells in your hands and palms facing one another directly under your shoulders.
Keeping a slight bend in your arms, exhale and lean back to an upright position while raising the dumbbells out to your sides and slightly back.
Continue until your torso is upright and your arms are parallel to the ground, maintaining a slight bend in them.
Inhale and lower the dumbbells while allowing your torso to lean slightly forward, returning to the starting position.

name: Seated Leg Curl Machine
pro_tip: To keep yourself firmly in the seat, try actively pulling yourself down towards it with the handles at your sides.
how_to: Sit down on the machine with your butt, lower back, and upper back firmly placed against it while you position your legs in front of the pad.
Set up the machine's backrest, seat height, and pad position so that your legs are parallel to the ground, with the pad pressed against the space between your calves and ankles.
Exhale and curl your legs down while holding onto the handles tightly with your hands.
Continue curling your legs until your feet are pointed directly towards the floor.
Inhale and allow your legs to extend until they are parallel with the floor, returning to the starting position.

name: Seated Rear Lateral Raise
pro_tip: Try to lift the dumbbells entirely through your shoulders, not your lower back.
how_to: Sit on a bench while leaning moderately forward with dumbbells in your hands and palms facing one another directly under your shoulders.
Keeping your arms straight, exhale and raise the dumbbells out to your sides and towards your upper back simultaneously with a shrugging motion.
Continue until your arms are parallel to the ground, keeping them straight.
Inhale and lower the dumbbells down while maintaining the forward lean in your torso, returning to the starting position.

name: Seated Row Machine
pro_tip: If you want to increase biceps involvement, grab the handles that are parallel to the floor instead, using an underhand grip.
how_to: Sit on the machine with your butt firmly planted, feet on the footrests, and chest pressed against the pad while gripping the handles with your palms facing each other.
Exhale and drive your elbows toward your back while squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Continue until your elbows pass your back.
Inhale and allow your arms to come forward while your shoulder blades part, returning to the starting position.

name: Shoulder Press Machine
pro_tip: If you are flexible, you can start with the handles immediately at your shoulder level for greater benefit.
how_to: Sit on the machine with your feet placed in front of you while your butt, back, and head are pressed firmly against the machine.
With an overhand grip, exhale and push the handles up from just above your shoulder-level, extending your arms overhead.
Continue pushing the handles overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Inhale and allow your arms to flex, lowering the handles down, returning to the starting position.

name: Shoulder Tap Push Up
pro_tip: If you are unable to raise your hand at the start of the movement, try raising it when your arm is almost completely straight instead. Do this until you're strong enough to perform the movement regularly.
how_to: Position yourself on the ground with your legs extended out behind you and hands  Shoulder level apart at the level of your upper chest.
Exhale and press yourself up by extending your arms.
As you extend, raise one hand up from the ground and move it towards your opposite shoulder.
Continue until the arm still on the ground is fully extended and your hand taps your shoulder.
Inhale and place your hand back on the ground to lower yourself down, returning to the starting position.
Switch sides.

name: Shrug
pro_tip: This movement will benefit from you performing it slowly, try to drag out the length of each rep by lowering the barbell back down slowly each time.
how_to: Stand upright, holding the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width apart with an overhand grip.
Keeping your arms straight, exhale and raise your shoulders with a shrugging motion to lift the barbell.
Continue to raise the barbell until you are no longer able to lift it through shrugging alone.
Inhale and lower the barbell, returning to the starting position.

name: Side Bend
pro_tip: Try not to pull on your head with your hand because it can lead to neck discomfort down the line.
how_to: Stand upright while gripping the handle and holding it by your side with a fully extended arm.
With your opposite hand behind your head, Inhale and bend your torso to the side opposite the dumbbell.
Continue until you are no longer able to lower yourself through exclusively bending to the side.
Exhale and raise yourself back up, returning to the starting position.
After all reps are completed, switch sides and repeat the movement. 10 reps prescribed means you should perform 10 reps on each side (20 total).

name: Side Plank
pro_tip: Do not forget to breathe rhythmically throughout the duration of the movement.
how_to: Lie on your side with your upper arm positioned directly under your shoulder and forearm rested on the ground, with your other hand on your hips.
Lift yourself up through raising your hips so that your body is straight and angled diagonally upward.
Hold this position for the duration of the movement.
Switch sides.
After all reps are completed, switch sides and repeat the movement. 10 seconds prescribed means you should perform 10 seconds on each side (20 total).

name: Side Plank Hip Adduction
pro_tip: Do not forget to breathe rhythmically for the duration of the movement.
how_to: Lie on your side with your upper arm positioned directly under your shoulder and forearm rested on the ground, with your other across your chest.
Place one foot on the ground and the other on a bench.
Raise your hips upward while raising your ground leg up to the bottom of the bench.
Hold yourself in this position for the duration of the movement.
After all reps are completed, switch sides and repeat the movement. 10 reps prescribed means you should perform 10 reps on each side (20 total).

name: Single Leg Box Squat
pro_tip: If you cannot squat low enough, start with a higher box, and gradually work your way down to a smaller one.
how_to: Position a box behind you and stand with feet shoulder-width apart with your arms raised at shoulder-level in front of you.
Raise one leg slightly in front of you while keeping it straight and balance on the leg that remains on the ground.
Inhale and break at the hips, sitting down and back in the direction of the box while simultaneously bringing your raised leg forward as you squat down.
Continue until your butt makes contact with the box while your raised leg is still in the air.
Exhale and press through your heel and midfoot while keeping your foot firmly planted until you stand upright, returning to the starting position.
After all reps are completed, switch sides and repeat the movement. 10 reps prescribed means you should perform 10 reps on each side (20 total).

name: Single Leg Dumbbell Deadlift
pro_tip: If you have difficulty balancing on one foot, try bending down less far while lowering yourself. Gradually progress to the full range of motion as you improve.
how_to: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding dumbbells in your hands with an overhand grip, and keeping your arms fully extended.
Raise one leg while keeping it straight and balance on the leg that remains on the ground.
While maintaining a flat back, inhale and lean forward with your torso while swinging your raised leg behind you, keeping it straight.
Continue until your torso and leg are parallel to the ground.
Exhale and press through your foot to raise your torso up while swinging your raised leg forward, returning to the starting position.
After all reps are completed, switch sides and repeat the movement. 10 reps prescribed means you should perform 10 reps on each side (20 total).

name: Single Leg Heel Touch Squat
pro_tip: Make sure you focus on maintaining a flat back when you bend your torso and lean forward to touch your heel.
how_to: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and hands by your sides.
Raise one leg while keeping it straight and balance on the leg that remains on the ground.
Inhale and lower yourself down by bending your planted leg and torso while simultaneously bending your raised leg back behind you
Continue to lower yourself down until your hands touch your heel.
Exhale and extend your planted leg while bringing your raised leg forward to return to the starting position.
After all reps are completed, switch sides and repeat the movement. 10 reps prescribed means you should perform 10 reps on each side (20 total).

name: Single Leg Squat
pro_tip: If you have the strength and flexibility, you can squat down farther and stop when your thigh is parallel to the ground.
how_to: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms by your sides.
Raise one leg in front of you while keeping it straight and balance on the leg that remains on the ground.
Inhale and break at the hips, sitting down and raising your arms forward while simultaneously bringing your raised leg forward as you squat down.
Continue until the thigh of your planted leg is slightly higher than parallel to the ground, without allowing your raised leg to touch the ground.
Exhale and press through your heel and midfoot while keeping your foot firmly planted until you stand upright, returning to the starting position.
After all reps are completed, switch sides and repeat the movement. 10 reps prescribed means you should perform 10 reps on each side (20 total).

name: Single Leg Stability Ball Squat
pro_tip: If you have the strength and flexibility, you can squat down farther and stop when your thigh is parallel to the ground.
how_to: Stand upright while pressing a stability ball against the wall with the middle of your back.
With your legs extended and out in front of you, closer than shoulder-width apart, inhale and raise one leg while squatting down with the other.

Continue to squat down while consciously pressing back against the ball, bringing your straight raised leg forward, and lowering your body until the thigh of your planted leg is just above parallel to the ground.
Exhale and stand up while bringing your raised leg back toward your body while continuing to actively press your back against the ball, returning to the starting position.
After all reps are completed, switch sides and repeat the movement. 10 reps prescribed means you should perform 10 reps on each side (20 total).

name: Sit Up
pro_tip: Try not to pull on your head with your hands because it can lead to neck discomfort down the line.
how_to: Lie down in a supine position with your knees bent and hands behind your head.
Exhale and raise your chest toward your knees.
Continue raising yourself up until you can no longer do so while still keeping your feet and butt firmly planted on the ground.
Inhale and lower your torso back down, returning to the starting position.

name: Sled Push
pro_tip: Remember to breathe rhythmically throughout the movement.
how_to: While holding onto the handles of the sled, bend forward so that your head is pointed forward and torso is approximately parallel with the ground.
With your legs behind you, push behind you extending one leg at a time while driving the other forward.
Repeat this motion for the desired duration or distance.

name: Sliding Floor Bridge Curl
pro_tip: If you do not have access to a slider, you can substitute it for another object that rolls, like a foam roller.
how_to: Lie supine on the floor with your arms by your side and a slider underneath the heels of your feet while raising your toes off of the ground.
Exhale and curl your legs toward you, drawing the slider to your body while raising your butt off the floor.
Continue until you cannot curl your legs further.
Inhale and allow your legs to extend out in front of you, pushing the slider away and returning to the starting position.

name: Sliding Floor Pulldown
pro_tip: If you do not have access to a slider, you can substitute it for another object that rolls, like a foam roller, and place it under the middle of your shin.
how_to: Position yourself on the ground with your legs bent, knees on a slider, and arms outstretched ahead of you slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Exhale and pull your body forward by pulling through your hands and raising your torso up slightly, making sure to keep your arms straight.
Continue until your hands are under the level of your lower chest.
Inhale and push through your hands while leaning your torso down, allowing yourself to return to the starting position.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
pro_tip: If you experience shoulder discomfort, try tucking your elbows in a little more.
how_to: Lie flat on the bench so that your head, upper back, lower back, and both feet are firmly pressed against the bench and ground at all points.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart above the middle of your chest.
Rotate your wrists to unhook the bar.
Inhale and lower the bar by bending your arms while keeping your elbows flared outward.
Continue to lower the bar until just before it makes contact with the middle of your chest.
Exhale and press the bar upward, extending your arms to return to the starting position.
Place the bar back on the hooks.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
pro_tip: You can substitute the item you are standing on for anything as long as it is sturdy, can support your weight, and will not move when you press on it.
how_to: Stand upright with feet closer than shoulder-width apart and facing forward on top of a step.
While holding onto the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width, rotate your wrists to unhook the bar.
While keeping your legs straight, exhale and press up through the ball of your feet and your toes to press yourself up.
Continue until you can no longer stand up any further on your toes.
Inhale and lower yourself down, returning to the starting position.
Place the bar back on the hooks.

name: Smith Machine Curl
pro_tip: Unlike other versions of the arm curl, your upper arm may need to move to perform this safely.
how_to: Stand upright with feet wider than shoulder-width apart and holding the bar with an underhand grip shoulder-width apart.
Rotate your wrists to unhook the bar.
Exhale and curl the bar upward by bending your arm and raising it in the direction of your shoulders.
Continue curling the bar until it reaches shoulder-level and you cannot curl it any further.
Inhale and lower the bar by bending your arm and bringing your upper arm back to your side, returning to the starting position.
Place the bar back on the hooks.

name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
pro_tip: If you experience shoulder discomfort, try tucking your elbows in a little more.
how_to: Lie flat on the bench so that your head, upper back, lower back, and both feet are firmly pressed against the bench and ground at all points.
Gripping the bar overhand and slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, rotate your wrists to unhook the bar.
Inhale and lower the bar down toward your chest, slightly tucking in your elbows as you lower it.
Continue lowering the bar until just before it makes contact with your upper chest.
Exhale and press through your hands, extending your arms upward to return to the starting position.
Place the bar back on the hooks.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
pro_tip: Try to avoid accidentally hitting your chin with the bar when you press up.
how_to: Sit on a bench that has a vertical backrest while in an upright position, holding the bar with an overhand grip wider than shoulder-width just above the level of your shoulders.
Rotate your wrists to unhook the bar.
Exhale and press the bar overhead, extending your arms while keeping your head faced forward.
Continue until your arms are fully extended.
Inhale and lower the bar by allowing your arms to lower with your elbows pointed downward, returning to the starting position.
Place the bar back on the hooks.

name: Smith Machine Shrug
pro_tip: Try to lower the bar slowly for greater benefit.
how_to: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended in front of you, holding the bar with an overhand grip closer than shoulder-width apart.
Rotate your wrists to unhook the bar.
Exhale and shrug your shoulders upward while keeping your arms straight to raise the bar.
Continue until you cannot shrug your shoulders any further while keeping your arms straight.
Inhale and lower your shoulders, returning to the starting position.
Place the bar back on the hooks.

name: Spiderman Burpee
pro_tip: The higher you jump, the more effective the movement will be.
how_to: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended by your sides.
Inhale and squat down while leaning forward with a straight torso, keeping your back flat.
Continue until you can place your hands on the ground in front of you shoulder-width apart and at the level of your shoulders.
Exhale and keep your hands on the ground while you kick off with your legs, extending them behind you to enter a push up position.
Inhale then exhale, raising one leg out to the side, rotating and bending it while lowering your torso down simultaneously.
Inhale then bring the leg back while straightening your arms and pushing up before doing the same with your other leg.
Exhale then jump forward, catching yourself in a squatting position with your hands on the ground.
Stand upright to jump and then catch yourself, returning to the starting position.

name: Spin Bike
pro_tip: Remember to breathe rhythmically throughout the duration of this movement.
how_to: Sit on the bike with your butt, lower back, and upper back positioned firmly on the machine.
Select the appropriate settings on the machine for your planned cardio.
Press start.
Push one leg down extending it while pulling the other up towards your torso.
Repeat this motion rhythmically for the duration of your cardio.

name: Sprinter Lunge
pro_tip: If you are not strong enough yet to stand up by only pushing through your front foot, you can use your hands and rear foot to help you while you gradually build up strength.
how_to: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and hands by your sides.
Inhale and raise one leg, taking a large step back while leaning forward with a flat torso and bending with your front leg.
Continue lowering yourself until your hands touch the floor and your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Exhale and push yourself up through your front foot while bringing your back leg forward, returning to the starting position.
After all reps are completed, switch sides and repeat the movement. 10 reps prescribed means you should perform 10 reps on each side (20 total).

name: Squat
pro_tip: When squatting, make sure you stay within the safety bars of the rack. Do not walk so far back that you are outside of their range.
how_to: With feet shoulder-width apart, position yourself under the center of the barbell in the rack as you place it between your traps and upper back, and grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell from the rack by partially standing up and taking a step back while squeezing the bar tightly and keeping it rested over your upper back.
Inhale and with feet pointed slightly outwards break at your hips, sitting down and allowing your torso to come moderately forward while keeping it straight.
Continue until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Exhale and push through your heels to return to the starting position.
After all reps are completed, walk forward to return the barbell to the rack.

name: Stability Ball Barbell Twist
pro_tip: Be extremely careful with this exercise, do not use a heavy weight if you can. Focus on staying balanced. Use a spotter. If possible, use a PVC pipe instead of a barbell for this exercise.
how_to: With feet shoulder-width apart, position yourself under the center of the barbell in the rack as you place it between your traps and upper back, and grip the barbell wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell from the rack by partially standing up and taking a step back while squeezing the bar tightly and keeping it rested over your upper back.
Sit upright on a stability ball with your feet firmly planted on the ground and pointed outward.
Exhale and twist your torso in one direction while keeping it completely upright.
Continue until you cannot do so any longer.
Inhale and rotate back, returning your torso to the starting position.
Switch sides.
After all reps are completed, stand up and return the barbell to the rack.

name: Stability Ball Crunch
pro_tip: Try to avoid pulling on your head with your hands because it can lead to neck discomfort later on.
how_to: Position yourself supine over the stability ball so that it presses into the middle of your back and your upper torso is leaned back.
With your legs bent in front of you and hands behind your head, exhale and curl your torso forward.

Continue to curl your torso forward while keeping your feet firmly planted on the ground and back pressed into the ball until your torso is almost upright. Do not allow your lower back to raise off the ball.
Inhale and lower your torso down, returning to the starting position.

name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
pro_tip: If you do not have access to a stability ball, you can improvise and use a foam roller instead.
how_to: Lie supine on the floor with your hands by your side, head firmly planted, and legs on top of the stability ball so that only your heels and lower legs are in contact with it.
While keeping your head firmly on the ground, exhale and curl the ball toward you by bending your legs and gradually shifting the part of your feet that make contact with the ball.
Allowing your hips to raise as you curl, continue to curl the ball until you can no longer do so while still keeping your head and arms firmly on the ground.
Inhale and extend your legs while lowering your hips, allowing the ball to return to the starting position.

name: Stability Ball Rollout
pro_tip: If you have trouble keeping your body stable during the movement, focus on consciously tightening your abs.
how_to: Position yourself on your knees with your forearms pressed into the stability ball.
With the stability ball slightly in front of your shoulders, inhale and lean forward rocking on your knees and extending your arms to roll the stability ball out in front of you.
Continue while pressing down on the stability ball until your arms are fully extended.
Exhale and rock back on your knees, drawing your arms in toward your body while continuing to press down on the stability ball to return to the starting position.

name: Stability Ball Sit Up
pro_tip: Try to avoid pulling on your head with your hands because it can lead to neck discomfort later on.
how_to: Position yourself supine over the stability ball so that it presses into your lower back and butt while your torso is leaned back.
With your legs bent in front of you and hands behind your head, exhale and curl your torso forward.
Continue to curl your torso forward while keeping your feet firmly planted on the ground and butt pressed into the ball until your torso is almost upright, allowing your lower back to raise.
Inhale and lower your torso down, returning to the starting position.

name: Starfish Crunch
pro_tip: Even though you raise your head up with your arm in this movement, try not to bend at your neck, keep your head straight while raising it.
how_to: Lie supine on the floor with your arms and legs fully extended and pointed outward in a jumping jack position.
Exhale while raising one arm and the opposite leg towards each other while keeping them straight and raising your head up alongside your arm.
Continue until your hand and foot touch, keeping your other arm and leg firmly planted on the ground.
Inhale and lower your arm and leg down, returning to the starting position while keeping them straight.
Switch sides.

name: Stepmill
pro_tip: Remember to breathe rhythmically throughout the movement.
how_to: Stand upright on the stepmill with feet shoulder-width apart.
Select the appropriate settings on the machine for your planned cardio.
Holding onto the handles to brace yourself, press start.
Walk up the steps like a normal set of stairs at the selected speed.
Continue this rhythmically for the desired duration of your cardio.

name: Stiff Legged Barbell Deadlift
pro_tip: Only perform this movement if you have excellent flexibility. If you cannot lift with mostly straight legs and a flat back, try a different type of deadlift.
how_to: Place a barbell on the floor and position yourself over the center of it with your feet shoulder-width apart and shins about 1 inch away from the barbell.
Maintaining a straight back and mostly straight legs, bend down while leaning forward and position your hands on the barbell shoulder-width apart with an overhand grip and fully extended arms.
Exhale and push through your feet to lift the barbell while maintaining a flat back and mostly straight legs.
Continue to raise the barbell up until you are standing upright. Do not lean your torso any further back than your hips.
Inhale and lower the barbell while keeping a flat back and allowing your legs to slightly bend, keeping them mostly straight and returning to the starting position.
Rest the barbell on the ground for 1 second between reps.

name: Straight Arm Bent Knee Crunch
pro_tip: If you want to make this movement easier, keep your hands angled diagonally up and back so that they are not directly overhead.
how_to: Lie supine on the floor with your arms raised overhead and knees bent in front of you.
Exhale and raise your chest up toward your knees while keeping your arms directly overhead and keeping your lower back in contact with the ground.
Continue to raise your chest and arms up as far as you can while keeping your lower back still on the ground.
Inhale and lower yourself down, returning to the starting position.

name: Straight Leg Kickback
pro_tip: To make the movement easier, kick your leg back without extending it, maintaining bent knees.
how_to: Position yourself on your knees with your hands shoulder-width apart at the level of your shoulders.
Exhale and raise one leg, kicking it back out behind you without allowing your torso to change its angle or body to rotate.
Continue kicking your leg back until it is greater than parallel with the floor and completely straight.
Inhale and bring your knee forward, returning your leg to the starting position.
After all reps are completed, switch sides and repeat the movement. 10 reps prescribed means you should perform 10 reps on each side (20 total).

name: Straight Leg Raise Hold
pro_tip: You can increase the difficulty of this movement by preventing your feet from touching the ground between reps.
how_to: Lie supine on the floor or a mat with your legs fully extended, arms straight, and head firmly planted.
Exhale and raise your legs up toward your torso while keeping them straight and the rest of your body firmly on the ground.
Continue raising your legs until your legs are pointed diagonally at a 45º angle.
Hold this position for several seconds.
Inhale and lower your legs down, returning to the starting position.

name: Straight Leg Raise To Knee Tuck
pro_tip: You can increase the difficulty of this movement by preventing your feet from touching the ground between reps.
how_to: Lie supine on the floor or a mat with your legs fully extended, arms straight by your sides, and head firmly planted.
Exhale and raise your legs up toward your chest while simultaneously bending them and keeping the rest of your body firmly planted on the ground.
Continue until just before your knees would make contact with your chest, allowing your butt to raise off the ground to do so.
Inhale and allow your legs to be pressed forward, lowering and extending them to return to the starting position.

name: Straight Leg Raise To Knee Tuck On Bench
pro_tip: To increase the difficulty of this movement, start by positioning yourself more forward on the bench so that your thighs are also hanging over the ledge.
how_to: Lie supine on a bench with your legs fully extended and hands behind your head gripping the bench for support.
Exhale and raise your legs up toward your chest while simultaneously bending them and keeping the rest of your body firmly planted on the bench.
Continue until just before your knees would make contact with your chest, allowing your butt to raise off the bench to do so.
Inhale and allow your legs to be pressed forward, lowering and extending them to return to the starting position.

name: Straight Leg Raise With Hip Lift
pro_tip: To make the movement easier, rest your legs on the ground between reps instead of keeping them elevated.
how_to: Lie on the ground with your straight legs raised while keeping your arms, torso, and head firmly planted on the ground.
Exhale and raise your legs toward your torso while keeping them straight, continuing until they are pointed straight up.
While your legs are pointed upward, raise your butt off the ground by lifting your hips to elevate your legs.
Inhale and lower your hips returning your butt to the ground and then bringing your legs forward to return to the starting position.

name: Sumo Squat
pro_tip: To increase the difficulty of this movement, continue until your thighs pass parallel to the ground.
how_to: Stand upright with your feet pointed outwards wider than shoulder-width apart and hands clasped in front of your chest.
Inhale and break at the hips to lower yourself toward the ground while bending at your knees.
Continue until your thighs are at least parallel with the ground.
Exhale and press through your feet until you are standing upright, returning to the starting position.

name: Superman Push Up
pro_tip: Consciously tighten your abs to prevent your hips from dropping as you raise yourself up.
how_to: Lie prone on the ground with your legs fully extended behind you and arms fully extended above you at shoulder-width.
While keeping your arms and legs straight, exhale and press down through your hands toward your feet to press yourself up.
Continue until you cannot go any higher while keeping your arms straight, legs straight, feet on the ground, and hands on the ground.
Inhale and lower yourself down, returning to the starting position.

name: T
pro_tip: To increase the range of motion and effectiveness of this movement, use smaller sized weight plates on the bar.
how_to: Stand over the bar with a flat back leaned forward slightly greater than parallel to the ground, with your arms extended underneath your shoulders.
Grasping the bar close to the plate without touching the plate, exhale and row the bar upward by driving your elbows toward your back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Continue raising the bar while tucking your elbows in until the plate stops you from bringing your arms back further, continuing to keep your torso and legs from moving.
Inhale and lower the bar down by extending at your arms and allowing your shoulder blades to part, returning to the starting position.

name: T
pro_tip: The further you lean forward, the more you'll focus on your upper back and the back part of your shoulders.
how_to: Stand with a flat back leaned forward slightly greater than parallel to the ground, with your arms extended underneath your shoulders, and your feet on the footrests.
Grasping the handles with an overhand grip, exhale and row the bar upward by driving your elbows toward your back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Continue raising the handles while flaring your elbows out until your elbows pass your torso.
Inhale and lower your arms down while allowing your shoulder blades to part, returning to the starting position.

name: Tricep Extension Machine
pro_tip: If you lean further forward so that your arms start out more bent, your triceps will be better trained, but the involvement of the long rear head of the triceps will increase proportionally.
how_to: Sit on the machine with your butt and feet firmly planted while resting your elbows on the pad and firmly gripping the handles.
Exhale and extend your arms forward, straightening them while keeping your elbows firmly pressed into the pad.
Continue until your arms are straight.
Inhale and allow your arms to return to the starting position.

name: Underhand Chair Inverted Row
pro_tip: As you get stronger, try to decrease the amount you extend at your knees.
how_to: Place a bar between two chairs.
Position yourself underneath the bar grabbing it with an underhand grip wider than shoulder-width and placing your feet out in front of you with your knees bent.
Exhale and row yourself towards the bar while allowing your knees to extend to aid you.
Continue until your upper chest can no longer get closer to the bar.
Inhale and lower yourself, returning to the starting position with arms fully extended.

name: V
pro_tip: If the pads do not firmly secure your thigh, they can be adjusted.
how_to: Sit down on the bench with your feet and butt firmly planted while securing your thighs with the pads and gripping the handle overhead.
While looking straight forward, exhale and drive your elbows downward and back while bending your arms.
Continue until your hands reach shoulder level.
Inhale and allow your arms to straighten overhead, returning to the starting position.

name: Weighted Decline Crunch
pro_tip: To increase the difficulty of the movement, hold the plate overhead instead of directly over your chest.
how_to: Lie on a bench with your feet secured behind pads while holding a weight plate directly above your chest with crossed arms.
Exhale and curl yourself up while keeping your lower back in contact with the bench.
Continue until you can no longer curl yourself up while keeping your lower back pressed firmly into the bench.
Inhale and lower yourself down, returning to the starting position.

name: Weighted Hanging Leg Raise To Knee Tuck
pro_tip: Exhale very deeply while raising your legs for added benefit.
how_to: Hang from the bar, gripping it overhand greater than shoulder-width apart while holding a dumbbell between your feet.
Exhale and raise your legs up, tucking them in as you go while continuing to tightly squeeze the dumbbell between your feet.
Continue until the dumbbell is close to the level of your hips.
Inhale and lower your legs down, returning to the starting position.

name: Weighted Twisting Crunch
pro_tip: Exhale very deeply while raising your legs and torso for added benefit.
how_to: Lie across the bench using your hands to hold yourself up while extending your legs straight ahead and holding a dumbbell between your feet by squeezing them together.
Exhale and curl your torso in one direction while raising up and tucking in your legs to meet it as you continue to press your feet together to hold the dumbbell.
Continue until you cannot curl yourself up any longer while keeping your butt pressed onto the bench.
Inhale, lowering your torso and legs back down to return to the starting position.
Switch sides.

name: Wide Grip Barbell Bench Press
pro_tip: If you experience shoulder discomfort, bring your hands slightly closer together and tuck your elbows in slightly throughout the movement.
how_to: Lie flat on a bench so that your head, upper back, lower back, and both feet are firmly pressed against the bench and ground at all points.
Grab the barbell with on the rack at much wider than shoulder-width by extending your arms and bring it forward until it is over your upper chest and your arms are fully extended.
Inhale and lower the barbell down while keeping your elbows flared out.
Continue until just before the barbell would make contact with your chest.
Exhale and press upwards, extending your arms to return to the starting position.

name: Wide Grip Barbell Curl
pro_tip: Try to avoid using your legs or back to lift the barbell.
how_to: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart holding the barbell with an underhand grip wider than shoulder-width apart.
Exhale and curl the barbell up toward your shoulders while keeping your upper arms by your sides.
Continue to raise the barbell until it reaches the level of your shoulders.
Inhale and lower the barbell by extending your arms, returning to the starting position.

name: Wide Grip Barbell Upright Row
pro_tip: Lower the barbell slowly on the way down for added benefit.
how_to: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding the barbell with an overhand grip much wider than shoulder-width apart.
Exhale and raise the barbell upward by shrugging at your shoulders and driving your elbows upwards.
Continue raising the barbell until it reaches the level of your upper chest and your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Inhale and lower the barbell down, returning to the starting position where your arms are fully extended.

name: Wipers
pro_tip: To increase the difficulty of this exercise, hold your legs in place for several seconds during the lowest point of the movement on each side of your body. Replicate whatever you do on one side on the other.
how_to: Lie supine on the floor with your arms extended out to your sides, and legs extended up towards the ceiling.
Inhale and lower your legs to one side, rotating your torso while keeping your back, arms, and head all flat on the ground.
Continue to lower your legs to the side as far as you can without allowing any part of your torso to come off the ground.
Exhale and raise your legs back towards the middle of your body, returning to the starting position.
Switch sides.

name: Zottman Curl
pro_tip: Try to avoid lifting the dumbbells with your back or legs, only use your arms.
how_to: Stand upright holding dumbbells in your hands with an underhand grip directly underneath your shoulders with your upper arms by your sides.
Exhale and curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders by bending your arms while keeping your upper arms pinned to your sides.
Continue raising the dumbbells until they reach shoulder level and you can no longer raise them.
Inhale and rotate your palms so that they are facing away from you.
Lower your arms down until they are fully extended and then rotate your palms forward, returning to the starting position.

name: Zottman Preacher Curl
pro_tip: If the pad gets in the way of you lifting the dumbbells, you can adjust the seat height to help you position your body so that the dumbbells can move more freely.
how_to: Sit with your elbows pressed firmly into the pad while holding two dumbbells with an underhand grip directly in front of your shoulders.
Exhale and curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders by bending your arms while keeping your elbows pressed into the pad.
Continue raising the dumbbells until they reach shoulder level and you can no longer raise them.
Inhale and rotate your palms so that they are facing away from you.
Lower your arms down until they are fully extended and then rotate your palms forward, returning to the starting position.
